settingsGuideDesc: How to enter numbers, use pencil notes, and play live with others.
helpGoalBody: Fill every row, column, and box with digits 1–9 (in 3×3) or 1–6 (in 2×3) without repeating any digit.
helpInputCellText: Tap an empty cell, then tap a digit on the number pad below.
helpInputLockText: With no cell selected, tap a digit to lock it, then tap several empty cells in a row to fill them quickly. Tap the digit again to unlock.
helpToolsNotesText: Turn on Notes to jot down small candidates in a cell. Use Fill Candidates or Clear Notes to manage them quickly.
helpToolsActionsText: Step back with Undo, clear a cell with Erase, or reveal one number with Hint.
helpToolsShiftText: Select a cell and use the Shift arrows below the number pad (or Shift + ↑↓←→) to swap rows or columns within the same box without breaking solvability.
helpLiveWatchText: Open Watch to see active games once players have started. Tap a match to spectate, tap an empty cell to suggest a digit or nudge players, and send emoji reactions.
helpLiveCoopText: Tap Join to solve together in real time: your digits appear in blue, and your partner's digits and selected cell appear in violet.
